A paragraph carrying <b>markup</b>, an & ampersand, a "quotation" and an
'apostrophe', so that a page rendering prose as markup is a page this fixture
catches on the prose as well as on the roster sentence.

What it needs before it is any use is a second block carrying <i>more</i> of the
same, because escaping that holds for the first paragraph and not the rest is a
failure the golden files should show.

What it does with data about a person is <script>nothing</script>, written that
way on purpose.
